subject: prd/prd-review
statement: Every surfaced finding shall carry: severity (blocking or advisory) assigned per the calibration table · its lens · evidence quoting the document span and the upstream anchor · and a **named acceptance condition**; a finding lacking any element shall not ship.
rationale: closable findings are the anti-ping-pong unit (— #D-2; T-1)
fit_criterion: 100% of findings across the corpus carry all four elements; a seeded closure-less candidate is blocked (EVAL-3)
